description: navigator.getBattery. Conditioned on the machine class: battery presence is a chassis property, and the host's real charge level is otherwise a per-user, drifting, near-unique value. Consumed by patch 0089.
label: battery

options.note: AUTHORED, NOT MEASURED. Times are multiples of 60 because macOS can only report whole minutes; level is 2dp because Blink rounds every platform's level to two decimals. One state per launch: two reads in one launch must agree.

options.note: AUTHORED, NOT MEASURED. Times are multiples of 60 because macOS can only report whole minutes; level is 2dp because Blink rounds every platform's level to two decimals. One state per launch: two reads in one launch must agree. This state resolves to chargingTime 0 and dischargingTime Infinity, which is byte-identical to what {present:false} produces, so a laptop drawing it is indistinguishable from a desktop through this API. That is kept deliberately: a laptop sitting fully charged on a charger is the single most common real laptop state, and the indistinguishability is a property of the API rather than a tell. The purpose of this axis is to stop the host's real, drifting, near-unique charge level from leaking, which this state does as well as any other. `charging-near-full` exists beside it so the charging branch is not all-or-nothing.
options.source: plausible battery state for a laptop machine class
